notes: Skills listed here stay in catalog/items.json and in sync/collection.json, but they are not installed on either computer.
A disabled skill is moved to ~/.config/opencode/skills-disabled/<name> by sync/prune-optional.py, so it can be restored without downloading it again.
Remove a name from this list, run sync-skills.ps1, and the skill is installed again.
